fps.screenshotWindow: Full page.screenshot API call plus checkpoint IPC; excludes decodePng/metric sorting, is not pure GPU time
limitations: No separate no-screenshot control; association does not isolate screenshot causation.
Different viewport sizes change rendering load. Between-image windows still include canvas visibility changes, two RAFs, metric processing, and waits.
Submitted frame counts are published synchronously after accepted renderer draws; they do not prove completion or screen presentation.
